QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788`) returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired and otherwise forwards the result. The `Tokenizer::tokenize` doc says "empty on failure or empty input", so an empty vector cannot be told apart from an empty prompt.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired and forwards the tokenizer's empty-on-failure result. So failure and the no-tokenizer case give the same empty value, which the answer says callers cannot tell apart.
